english.title: Manufacturer of electrical equipment presenting risk fail to inform market surveillance authority / national authority
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a manufacturer of electrical equipment, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUIPMENT..), that presented a risk, failed to inform immediately the market surveillance authority, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AUTHORITY..), and the competent national authority of any other member State in which you made the electrical equipment available on the market, namely **(..SPECIFY AUTHORITY AND MEMBER STATE..), of the risk, giving details of the respect in which the electrical equipment was considered not to be in conformity with Part 2 of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016 and any corrective measures taken
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 12(2), 50(1) and 51(1) of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The legislation was amended due to the EU Exit. For offences from 1st January 2021, see H20903.
(ii) There is also an offence of failure to take corrective action under regulation 12(1) of the Electrical Equipment (Safety) Regulations 2016, H18740.

other.penalty:
